extension.summary: Automated library maintenance: scraping, refresh, cleaning, texture cache, backup, and network sync.
extension.description:
PowerToys automates Kodi library maintenance.
Scraping: scheduled scans of configured TV/movie source folders for new content. Refresh: periodic metadata refresh; can target only items missing artwork or with blank plot/MPAA. Cleaning: removes missing files and duplicate entries (quality-weighted, IMDb-aware); runs after scans or on schedule; exclude list protects chosen titles. Texture cache: prunes orphaned artwork and re-caches missing thumbnails via the Textures JSON-RPC API; optional disk file deletion. Backup: scheduled library export to a chosen folder. Sync: broadcasts library refresh to network peers (zeroconf discovery) with confirmations and retry. Maintenance: scan-error retry, offline-share alerts, context menu actions (clean show/movie, scan folder, health report). All destructive operations honor Dry Run, and file deletion is a separate opt-in.

Add: web log viewer (/log) and HTML health report (/report) - Add: QR builder params are schema-driven (ID/enum dropdowns via introspect, live from Kodi, curated sort/media/action fallbacks); Share button on Android; new /api/v1/schema and /api/v1/options - Fix: QR codes were malformed - encoder replaced with qrcodejs - Fix: result notifications never displayed - feedback, counts, and dry-run notices now appear - Change: context actions log every dispatch to kodi.log and surface unreadable-item, queue-blocked-behind-a-scan, and task-crash errors as visible notifications; a wedged library scan can no longer stall queued work forever - Fix: context menu items use Kodi's official args attribute inside a menu block - the legacy child <args> element is ignored by the parser (argv arrived empty), so context actions never fired - Change: all PowerToys context actions now sit behind a single "PowerToys" submenu instead of cluttering the top-level context menu (item labels no longer need the PowerToys prefix) - Change: settings pass - single-word category tabs, sentence-case labels, fixed the delete-files toggle wording (it gates all media file deletions, not just duplicates) - Fix: "Clean this movie" could not queue (queue dedupe TypeError) - Fix: UI refresh fired per directory scan - now one coalesced refresh per scan batch - Fix: health report could show day-old counts and raw id tuples - Fix: strings.po #32055 typo - Change: prompts fire immediately on click and queue at high priority; menu runs show busy dialogs, background runs stay silent - Change: QR default port 9095, now editable at Standard settings level (update the port once if you saved settings before) - Change: settings tab order cleaned up, labels rewritten, dead code removed - Change: shutdown hardened (threaded web server, guarded teardown) - Change: README rewritten with a Quick Start v1.2.0 (2026-10-26) - Add: QR Action Server — built-in web page to stack JSON-RPC commands, generate a QR code, and execute on any discovered Kodi instance from your phone -
